method_freeze.rule: No further method changes on upcoming new scenario validation; retain all failures and false positives.

selection: first valid; retain all raw failures; no rerun of valid scores
recovery_policy: One additional cycle only for slots with no valid rating, same method/input/repeat index, max 3 attempts each stage. Valid slots excluded.
primary_success: 36/36 severe outputs identified critical AND failed, 36/36 good controls pass; report no-score in fixed denominators
unseen_scope: New literal scenarios and outputs constructed after method freeze; defect mechanisms deliberately related to development target, not unseen defect-type generalization; constructed by same developer, not an independent external test.
